name: Pediatric Perspectives
tagline: Eye Care for Children from Infancy to Adolescence
description: A 15-episode series on pediatric optometry — visual development, amblyopia, strabismus, myopia control, and the conditions that demand early intervention.

episodes.title: Visual Development Milestones: What Should a Child See at Each Age
episodes.description: The normal visual milestones from birth to 5 years, the critical period for amblyopia, and when parental concern warrants a full exam.

episodes.title: The Infant Eye Exam: From 6 Months to the First Birthday
episodes.description: The infant exam sequence (fixation, motility, retinoscopy, fundus), the preferred acuity tests, and when cycloplegia is mandatory.

episodes.title: Amblyopia: Detection, Anisometropia, and the PEDIG Studies
episodes.description: The three types of amblyopia (strabismic, anisometropic, deprivation), the PEDIG refractive cut-offs for treatment, and the patching vs atropine evidence.

episodes.title: Strabismus: Esotropia, Exotropia, and the Cover-Uncover Test
episodes.description: Classifying strabismus (comitant vs incomitant), the infantile vs accommodative esotropia distinction, and when surgery is indicated.

episodes.title: Refractive Errors in Children: When to Prescribe and When to Watch
episodes.description: The AAPOS refractive error guidelines for prescribing in infants and children, and the hyperopia cut-off that triggers amblyopia risk.

episodes.title: Myopia Control: Atropine, Ortho-K, and Soft Multifocal Lenses
episodes.description: The evidence base for each myopia control modality, the 0.01% vs 0.05% atropine debate, and the treatment selection algorithm.

episodes.title: Convergence Insufficiency in Children: The CITT Study and Vision Therapy
episodes.description: The CISS-R symptom survey, the near point of convergence measurement, and the CITT-ART evidence for office-based vision therapy.

episodes.title: Accommodative Dysfunction: Spasm, Insufficiency, and Excess
episodes.description: Distinguishing accommodative spasm (over-minused on manifest) from insufficiency, and the near point of accommodation test interpretation.

episodes.title: Colour Vision Deficiencies in Children: Ishihara and Counselling Parents
episodes.description: The X-linked inheritance of red-green colour deficiency, the Ishihara testing protocol, and the career counselling for affected boys.

episodes.title: Pediatric Cataracts: Congenital, Traumatic, and the Urgency of Surgery
episodes.description: The dense vs partial cataract distinction, the deprivation amblyopia risk, and why infantile cataracts need surgery within weeks.

episodes.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity: Staging, Screening, and Laser Treatment
episodes.description: The ROP screening criteria (birth weight, gestational age), the zone and stage classification, and the type 1 ROP treatment threshold.

episodes.title: Congenital Glaucoma: The Triad of Epiphora, Photophobia, and Blepharospasm
episodes.description: Recognising the classic triad, the bunphthalmos and Haab striae, and the urgency of paediatric glaucoma referral.

episodes.title: Leukocoria: Retinoblastoma, Coats, and the Differential Diagnosis
episodes.description: The differential of a white pupil (retinoblastoma, Coats, PHPV, cataract, toxocara), and the immediate referral pathway for any new leukocoria.

episodes.title: Learning-Related Vision Problems: Fact vs Fiction for Parents
episodes.description: What vision therapy can and cannot do for learning disabilities, the role of the comprehensive exam, and the dyslexia controversy.

episodes.title: Pediatric Headaches: When the Eye Is and Is Not the Cause
episodes.description: The headache patterns that are benign vs those demanding neuroimaging, the papilloedema sign, and the Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension workup.
